premises: Alloying Cr with ~10 at.% Al promotes a continuous, dense Cr2O3–Al2O3 composite oxide scale.
This composite scale retards oxygen diffusion and limits Cr–Zr interdiffusion.
Excess Al (≥17 at.%) leads to deleterious intermetallic phases and oxide discontinuities.
